description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named EmployeeSalarySearchFilterParams used for filtering employee salary search results in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base filter parameters class and includes properties and methods related to employee number and sorting fields.

classes.name: EmployeeSalarySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying filtering parameters when searching employee salary records.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value, or null if not set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.
